FAQ

Before you ask.

Does it need the internet?

No. Everything runs inside your office network. Internet is only needed if you want remote updates, and that's optional.

Is it as strong as ChatGPT?

For everyday work — summarizing, writing, searching your files, translating — it's very close. On very complex problems, the big cloud models are stronger. Our edge: it knows your files, and doesn't leak them.

How many people can use it at once?

The Office plan is comfortable for up to 15 daily active users. If several people ask in the same second, answers take a few seconds longer. For bigger teams, the Company plan.

Which files does it read?

PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and text, in Arabic and English. We connect only the network folders you choose.

Who sees what?

Every employee has an account and every department its own file space. You set the permissions, and we configure them with you on installation day.

Does it help with PDPL compliance?

Keeping data inside your building makes compliance much easier, because nothing is transferred to a third party. We don't give legal advice, though; check with your counsel for your case.

What if the device fails?

It carries the manufacturer's warranty, and during the care period we replace or repair it and restore your setup.
